bio: Ready for a dose of French savoir-vivre in Berlin? You almost feel like you are in France here in the heart of Charlottenburg at Brasserie Lamazère thanks to its charming, down-to-earth and lively atmosphere. The regularly changing seasonal dishes are chalked up on the blackboard. You can put together your menu (starter, main, dessert) from a fine selection. They will be happy to recommend a good French wine pairing to accompany your food – the appealing and reasonably priced wine list is proprietor Régis Lamazère's passion....
